headline_findings.ST_vs_Mohun_exploitation_rate_ratio: Range [1.020, 1.304] over 1948-1989 — ST consistently 2-30% higher than Mohun depending on year. Documents the sensitivity of the exploitation rate to productive/unproductive boundary choice.
headline_findings.Cronin_NZ_rate_of_surplus_value: Rose 206 (1972) -> 307 (1995) percent — sharp increase in NZ post-reform surplus extraction.
headline_findings.Tonak_1984_net_tax: Endpoints 1952=$16B, 1980=$35B — net positive tax on labor across the full Tonak period (consistent with negative NSW finding).

strengths: 10 ES series implemented in one push using the same template proven in Ch5/Ch6
ES1404 (ST/Mohun ratio) provides a clean cross-validation metric — vindicates the Anu Framework's cross-study comparison design
Source data for the 10 implemented studies copied byte-faithful from ST2's ExternalSources; no proxy substitutions
gaps: ST 1987/2002 derivations (5 series) need EC denominator — same blocker as for any ratio normalization
Moos 2017 (4 series) needs a BEA NIPA loader (same blocker as Wave 3's S201)
Karabacak Turkey 2022 (2 series) needs paper's exact formula applied to the inputs we already have

recommendation: PARTIAL CLOSE. 10/25 ES series implemented with full validation. The remaining 15 have clear activation paths documented in their DPRs. Wave 5 (4 analytical series) and the K*/TCU sourcing are the natural next moves.
